Direct question asked repeatedly in railway exams.
Unlike the USA, there is no separate state citizenship.

items: Questions on Single Citizenship versus Dual Citizenship (USA model) are asked repeatedly in Railway and SSC examinations.
Remember that Indian Constitution provides for a single uniform citizenship for the entire country.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Only Indian citizenship exists for citizens across all states and union territories.
India does not offer or permit a separate state-level citizenship.
The Indian citizenship structure stands in contrast to federal systems like the USA.
